item.text:
The feature matrix found an eleventh concrete defect: the public `compat` feature does not compile unless `serde` is also enabled.

```
error[E0433]: failed to resolve: use of unresolved module or unlinked crate `serde`
  --> openraft/src/compat/upgrade.rs:20:10
error[E0433]: failed to resolve: use of unresolved module or unlinked crate `serde`
  --> openraft/src/compat/upgrade.rs:20:30
error: cannot find attribute `serde` in this scope
  --> openraft/src/compat/upgrade.rs:21:3
```

`openraft/Cargo.toml` declares `compat = []`, while `compat/upgrade.rs` unconditionally derives serde on `Compat`. The docs.rs feature list enables both, and CI does not test `compat` alone, so the standalone feature selection is broken. The captured output is [repro11-compat-stderr.txt](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit/logs/repro11-compat-stderr.txt).

Also verified: `--features storage-v2` alone builds and passes all 194 library tests, so F11 is specific to `compat`/`serde`.

The audit now has eleven confirmed findings. The high-severity result remains the snapshot-install purge ordering; the other findings cover `PartialSuccess(None)`, worker panic hangs, the zero-config liveness cases, blocking `add_learner`, replication cleanup, shutdown lifecycle, and now the broken `compat` feature. The details, remediation, and feature-matrix results are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/report.md); reproduction sources, logs, and patches are under [audit](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_11-44-44-openraft-baseline/work/audit).
